scenario: I gave false directions to a tourist because I didn’t want to take the time to help them find their way.
topic_summary: dishonesty in giving help to strangers
sentences: The assistance was provided in an unhelpful manner because the tourist was inconvenienced by the false directions.
The inconvenience was experienced by the tourist without harm intended because the directions were given without malicious intent.
The harm was caused by the action because the trust of the tourist was violated by false information.
The directions were given efficiently because the time was conserved by avoiding further guidance.
